question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentences. 1×5= 5 Column A Column B Column C (a) Environment pollution (i) we walk on both in (i)) by smoke of factories and (b) In our cities air urban and rural areas vehicles. (c) Even the ground (ii) in various ways (ii) in our country. guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Environment pollution has become one of the greatest problems in this modern age. (b) In our cities air is constantly being polluted by smoke of factories and vehicles. (c) Even the ground we walk on both in urban and rural areas is polluted by garbage. (d) Water is also polluted in various ways in our country. (e) But we should not remain idle in the face of alarming pollution.
